title: Beyond Demographics: Aligning Role-playing LLM-based Agents Using Human Belief Networks

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Mean Absolute Error (MAE) between actual human survey responses and LLM agent responses when the model is prompted to role-play specific human demographic profiles (including age, gender, education, race, income, and rural/urban residency).

Evaluating the alignment of LLM-generated opinions with human survey data on highly polarized topics (such as Partisan issues, Economics, and Trump) by querying the models with factual propositions and measuring the discrepancy on a six-point Likert scale.
